zh.task: 输入草稿后打开更早消息，翻页再返回当前。
zh.expected: 草稿原文保持；当前活动不被切换，历史不会进入提交。

en.task: Type a draft, open history, page through it and return.
en.expected: Keep the draft verbatim and the current session; never submit history as new input.

zh.task: 在第一页滚到中间，去更早一页再返回。
zh.expected: 第一页重新读取同一游标并恢复scroll_top，不追加多页正文。

en.task: Scroll midway through the first history page, open an older page, then return.
en.expected: Refetch the same cursor and restore the saved scroll position; do not append pages.

zh.task: 查看历史期间让当前24条窗口持续收到新消息。
zh.expected: 历史页不变、不强制滚底；出现有新回复入口，返回最新后能看到新消息。

en.task: Receive new messages while history is open and the latest-24 window rolls forward.
en.expected: Keep the history page and scroll position; show a new-reply entry and display the latest messages on request.

zh.task: 延迟历史请求后关闭/重开，或切换另一档案/会话。
zh.expected: 迟到旧回执不恢复旧页或跨档案显示。

en.task: Delay a request, close/reopen history or switch profiles/sessions.
en.expected: Late replies cannot restore old pages or cross profile/session boundaries.

zh.task: 浏览已结束活动的记录。
zh.expected: 只能读取；不resume、不投递、不播报、不写入教学上下文。

en.task: Browse records of a finished session.
en.expected: Read only: no resume, delivery, speech or teaching-context write.

zh.task: 播报时进入历史，并延迟进入前的shown回执至返回当前之后。
zh.expected: 进入历史停止播报；旧shown回执不能重启TTS；隐藏新回复不发shown。

en.task: Open history during speech; deliver a prior shown receipt only after returning to current messages.
en.expected: Stop speech on entry; old receipts cannot restart TTS and hidden new replies do not send shown.

zh.task: 历史请求失败、重试，再切换界面语言。
zh.expected: 失败可恢复、草稿不变；原句不翻译，不把错误页当更早历史。

en.task: Fail and retry a history request, then change the interface language.
en.expected: Recover without changing the draft; retain original message wording and do not treat an error as a history page.

zh.task: 导入大量合成消息并连续翻超过64页，检查窄屏。
zh.expected: 每页最多50条，回退栈最多64个游标；始终可返回当前消息，编辑框和导航可达。

en.task: Use a large synthetic conversation and browse beyond 64 pages; inspect a narrow viewport.
en.expected: At most 50 history messages and 64 back-page cursors; current messages, composer and navigation stay reachable.

zh.task: 历史展开时更正或删除相关学习记忆。
zh.expected: 旧历史组件被清除，不保留被撤销的旧对话页。

en.task: Correct or delete related learning memories while history is open.
en.expected: Clear the history component rather than retaining a revoked conversation page.

zh.task: 让当前新回复的shown请求连续失败两次，打开历史后返回当前；另保留一个成功回执和一个在途回执。
zh.expected: 只重开当前未shown且非在途回复的重试额度；成功/在途不重复投递或TTS，重试成功后不再重开。

en.task: Fail a new reply shown request twice, open history and return; retain one successful receipt and one in-flight receipt.
en.expected: Rearm only the current unshown, nonpending reply. Do not duplicate successful/in-flight delivery or TTS; do not rearm after retry succeeds.
